meta.title: Context Window Configurator
meta.description: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third 'Context window' row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, and provider-wide sync.

enabled.title: Enable Plugin
enabled.description: Whether to enable the Context Window manual configuration row in the composer model selector.

showInTrigger.title: Show Capacity in Trigger
showInTrigger.description: Whether to compactly display the current context window capacity (e.g. 256K) on the composer model trigger button.

defaultSyncAllProviderModels.title: Sync All Models in Provider by Default
defaultSyncAllProviderModels.description: Default state of the 'Apply to all models of this provider' toggle in the context window pane.
